Gameplay measurements are being prepared.

How is the score calculated?

Each scenario converts its native reward to a score between 0 and 1 using fixed task rules. We average the seeds within each scenario, then average all scenarios equally and multiply by 100. Scores of 80, 40 and 0 therefore produce a suite score of 40/100.

Aborted episodes count as zero. An incomplete suite receives no aggregate score. Normalization anchors are task-specific, not human performance or IQ. Families with more scenarios have more weight; the score is not the percentage of games beaten.

Speed is a separate gate: every measured response must be strictly below 100 ms, with no errors or aborted episodes. Slower models can still appear in the exhibition. One seed and eight decisions are only an integration demonstration; many games barely start.

    // 02 / THE PLAYING FIELD

    Game index.

    36 of 45 environment cards now contain a validated task, covering 43 runnable scenarios. The remaining nine need further replay validation, game-specific adapters or usable game installations. Library cards cover only the tasks named in their details. Every validated card includes a screenshot and a short clip from recorded evaluation frames. Three experimental cards show unranked native diagnostic captures; other candidates use credited project previews. These previews are not benchmark results. Clips play only when selected. Ten new tasks now cover Unity, Football, SuperTuxKart, Luanti, SuperTux, Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup, OpenTTD, Mindustry, Cataclysm: DDA and Warzone 2100; the current model exhibition evaluates all 43 scenarios, while the previous 33-scenario cohort remains separate. Their separate validation includes 21 control runs and 4,303 decisions, all replay-verified. Download the new integration evidence.

    01 / MEASURE

    The whole response path.

    Snapshot retrieval, image encoding, transport, inference and validation. Engine updates between decisions are outside the clock; these are lockstep tasks, not continuous real-time gameplay.

    02 / COMPARE

    The same playing field.

    Fixed scenarios, identical seed sets, equal game weights and visible uncertainty. Exhibition and realtime runs stay separate.

    03 / VERIFY

    Replay the evidence.

    Referee scores, fresh observation challenges, frame hashes and replayable action traces. No self-reported rewards.
